services.desc: The home of Skill-Based Fitness - real boxing technique meets a high-energy, full-body workout. Build confidence, get fit, and learn real skills in a community that's in your corner. Step into the gym with zero experience and leave feeling like a champion. Our coaches break down real USA Boxing technique step-by-step so you learn the right way while getting the best workout of your life. Simple, flexible plans with no hidden fees. Pick the one that fits your schedule. A 1-hour Boxing Fitness Class designed to get you a total-body workout - combining boxing techniques, conditioning and core exercises. No boxing experience
